about_the_game:
One click. One stormy night. Two worlds connected.

Charlie is home alone during a thunderstorm. On his old computer, a mysterious program appears: Golden Clicker. When he opens it, there’s only a golden button. Every time he presses it, particles emerge, numbers rise… and entire universes begin to form.

But soon, he realizes he’s not just building a virtual world. Lights flicker. The clock speeds up. Shadows move. And a voice whispers from the dark: “Your duty is to create the perfect universe…”

👁️ The Watcher is always watching. Always judging. Never satisfied.

In Golden Clicker, clicking isn’t enough. Whenever something strange happens on the screen, you’ll need to exit the program and tend to Charlie’s room. Ignoring the signs could mean losing your progress… or something far worse.

🕹️ Key Features

🔘 Click to create – Generate matter, energy, and life with every press.

🌌 Build a universe – From particles to galaxies and beyond.

🧠 Dual-world gameplay – Switch between Charlie’s digital creation and his haunted reality.

👁️ A lurking presence – The Watcher reacts to your choices.

⚠️ Paranormal events – Lights, sounds, shadows… is it real or simulated?

♟️ Strategic progression – Every upgrade has consequences.

Will your creation be perfect enough… …before the program consumes you?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Microsoft Windows 7/8/8.1/10 (32bit/64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 Display
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Microsoft Windows 7/8/8.1/10 (32bit/64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL ES 2.0 hardware driver support required for WebGL acceleration. (AMD Catalyst 10.9, nVidia 358.50)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
